cases.question: How many customers don't have a state recorded?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE State IS NULL LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE State IS NULL

cases.question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE Composer IS NULL LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE Composer IS NULL

cases.question: How many tracks have never been sold?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE NOT TrackId IN (SELECT DISTINCT TrackId FROM invoice_items) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM invoice_items)

cases.question: How many artists have no albums?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artists WHERE NOT ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM albums) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artists WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM albums)

cases.question: How many invoices were issued in the first quarter of 2010?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2010-04-01' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01' AND InvoiceDate < '2010-04-01'

cases.question: How many invoices were issued in December, across all years?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE STRFTIME('%m', InvoiceDate) = '12' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) = '12'

cases.question: How many different customers have bought at least one Jazz track?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CustomerId) FROM customers AS T1 JOIN invoices AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId JOIN invoice_items AS T3 ON T2.InvoiceId = T3.InvoiceId JOIN tracks AS T4 ON T3.TrackId = T4.TrackId JOIN genres AS T5 ON T4.GenreId = T5.GenreId WHERE T5.Name = 'Jazz' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM invoices i JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId JOIN genres g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

cases.question: What is the average track length in minutes, rounded to 2 decimals?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) AS AverageLengthMinutes FROM tracks LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) FROM tracks

cases.question: How many albums have more than 20 tracks?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT AlbumId FROM tracks GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT AlbumId FROM tracks WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20)

cases.question: Which employees have never been the support rep for any customer? Return their first and last names.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM employees WHERE NOT EmployeeId IN (SELECT DISTINCT SupportRepId FROM customers WHERE NOT SupportRepId IS NULL) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM employees WHERE EmployeeId NOT IN (SELECT SupportRepId FROM customers WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL)

cases.question: What percentage of invoices have a billing country of USA? Round to 2 decimals.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS Percentage FROM invoices LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM invoices

cases.question: Which 3 genres brought in the most revenue from track sales? Return the genre name and the revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity), 2) AS Revenue FROM genres AS g JOIN tracks AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN invoice_items AS ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 3
cases.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity), 2) FROM genres g JOIN tracks t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: How many tracks are longer than the average track?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM tracks) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM tracks)

cases.question: How many customers have bought tracks from at least 5 different genres?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.CustomerId FROM customers AS c JOIN invoices AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN invoice_items AS ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId JOIN tracks AS t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE NOT t.GenreId IS NULL GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) >= 5) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.CustomerId FROM invoices i JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId GROUP BY i.CustomerId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) >= 5)

cases.question: Which support employee's customers spent the most in total? Return the employee's first and last name only.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM employees AS e JOIN customers AS c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId JOIN invoices AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1
cases.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many invoices have more than 5 line items?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT InvoiceId FROM invoice_items GROUP BY InvoiceId HAVING COUNT(*) > 5) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT InvoiceId FROM invoice_items GROUP BY InvoiceId HAVING COUNT(*) > 5)

cases.question: What was the total of all invoices in 2012, rounded to 2 decimals?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM invoices WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012'

cases.question: How many customers use a Gmail address?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Email LIKE '%@gmail.com' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Email LIKE '%@gmail.com'

cases.question: How many different artists have at least one track that was sold?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ArtistId) FROM invoice_items AS T1 INNER JOIN tracks AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId INNER JOIN albums AS T3 ON T2.AlbumId = T3.AlbumId INNER JOIN artists AS T4 ON T3.ArtistId = T4.ArtistId LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.ArtistId) FROM invoice_items ii JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId JOIN albums al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId

cases.question: How many customers live in a country where the company also has an employee?
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Country IN (SELECT Country FROM employees) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Country IN (SELECT Country FROM employees)
